# Neave Tech
> High-performance digital infrastructure for government and enterprise. Nagpur-based IT company building ERP, IoT, cloud, AI and web systems since 2019.

Neave Tech is a brand of Neave Corporation Private Limited (CIN U72900PN2019PTC182121). Founded 2019-02-12. ISO-certified, MSME/Udyam registered. Headquartered in Nagpur, Maharashtra, India.
